name: Type: Error
ability: System Error (its own: makes it Error type in battle)
look: a lean, dark biped with a spiked brown mask and one glaring eye, a white spiky mane, a silver pincer claw with glowing cyan tips on one arm and a huge blue fin club on the other
entry: A failed experiment built to be faster and deadlier than any other. The mask clamped over its head keeps its corrupted power in check. Its type cannot be read: every attack hits it the same, except the most ordinary ones.
how: Wild: extremely rare in the Deep Dark (level 50-60). Genderless; it cannot breed.
